# Fabric Commander Gateway 2.2.7

## Universal MCP connection wizard
- Provider-neutral onboarding for HTTPS MCP services, including NOC & Control, Lexit Apps and internal MCP endpoints.
- Optional, validated IPv4/IPv6 DNS resolver configuration and the existing trusted CA bundle survive initial installation, updates and recovery across supported Linux-based hosts.
- Clearer DNS, TLS, OAuth, callback and tool-discovery error states; actual OAuth grants and user-selected server trust control tool approval.
- Explicitly approved server-wide trust can discover available tools with pinned schemas. Permissions are never silently elevated.

## Chat titles and operations
- Task-relevant chat titles take priority over generic system-diagnostic defaults.
- Retains the registered RSA-SHA256 public-update trust root, matching Gateway and Project Worker images, and verified rollback support.
- Supports x86_64 Debian/Ubuntu Linux VMs and Unraid. Native desktop clients keep their independent release channels.

Public distribution does not install a release on PROD. The operator selects the update in the existing Gateway Update Center. OAuth consent remains under the provider user's control.
